If the plan expires, or no fresh plan arrives for 3.0 h, the inverter returns to its native settings and keeps at least 20 % state of charge. Reasons in this plan Why each slot does what it does; hover a chip in the table for the slot's own figures. Idle Nothing to gain from moving energy in this slot. (130 slots) Genset off The grid is up, so the genset stays off although an outage is likely soon. (2 slots) MDI cap Discharging to keep the maximum demand under its cap. (2 slots) Charge from grid Charging from the grid while energy is cheaper. (2 slots) Wear > saving Not discharging: the price gap is smaller than the battery's wear cost. (6 slots) Hold for outage Keeping charge in reserve: a likely outage. (26 slots) Keep for later Keeping charge at the end of the horizon for the following day.
